Google CEO acknowledges AI race challenges, new tools launched

Google CEO Sundar Pichai has stated that the company is falling behind rivals like Anthropic and OpenAI in a specific area of AI development: agentic coding technology. This capability is described as a crucial and lucrative battleground in the AI industry. In response, Google has introduced new tools, Antigravity 2.0 and Gemini 3.5 Flash, to address this gap, with internal adoption showing positive signs.
